prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters, MO is **World Martial Arts Academy**, which offers a dedicated kids program and beginner classes for ages **4–5**, **6–10**, and **11+** at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd.**[1][8][13]

Other solid local options include **All Star Karate**, which emphasizes a structured, encouraging environment and offers a free introductory program, and **Gracie Barra St. Peters**, which offers kids jiu-jitsu and positions itself as a kids-focused option in the area.[5][11][3][7]

If you want the best fit, consider:
- **Younger kids / first-time students:** World Martial Arts Academy or All Star Karate[5][8][13]
- **Kids interested in grappling / jiu-jitsu:** Gracie Barra St. Peters[3][7]
- **Convenient nearby options:** ATA Martial Arts St. Peters and Revive Brazilian Jiu Jitsu also appear in local youth-sports listings.[12][7]

A practical next step is to visit 2–3 schools, watch a class, and ask about age groups, instructor experience, trial classes, and monthly costs.
